raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "workalendar" %}
{% set version = "17.0.0" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/{{ name[0] }}/{{ name }}/{{ name }}-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: b82d6024aed452505b01baf06dbe8d6309a3135ff1d39dee07c31b21ece853b4

build:
  noarch: python
  number: 2
  script: '{{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . --no-deps --ignore-installed -vv '

requirements:
  host:
    - pip
    - python {{ python_min }}

  run:
    - python >={{ python_min }}
    - python-dateutil
    - lunardate
    - backports.zoneinfo
    - tzdata
    - convertdate
    - pyluach
    - importlib-metadata

test:
  imports:
    - workalendar
    - workalendar.africa
    - workalendar.america
    - workalendar.asia
    - workalendar.europe
    - workalendar.europe.scotland
    - workalendar.europe.scotland.mixins
    - workalendar.oceania
    - workalendar.usa
  commands:
    - pip check
  requires:
    - pip
    - python {{ python_min }}

about:
  home: https://github.com/peopledoc/workalendar
  license: MIT
  license_family: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE.txt
  summary: Worldwide holidays and working days helper and toolkit.

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - Matt-BF
